info.desc: Niggas on the Moon is the first disc of The Powers That B. It was released as a free digital download on June 8, 2014. The first disc's instrumentation was performed entirely on a Roland V-Drum kit by drummer Zach Hill and features chopped vocal samples of Icelandic singer-songwriter Björk on every track. .

podcast.body: This was the first part of "The Powers That B" double album, released for free online. It achieved overwhelming success and garnered immense critical praise. The album features numerous samples and contributions from artists like Björk, and was admired by figures such as Pizorno of Kasabian and David Bowie, influencing many in the underground scene. "ellos publicaron de manera gratuita la primera parte de este doble álbum Niggas, on Demon que tuvo un éxito arrollador y la crítica alucinó con él."
